styles.name: The Recorder
styles.blurb: You hold things. What was on the screen is still on the screen for you a beat after it goes, and most of what people call your attention is really just that you never quite put the last thing down. The Recorder sharpens fastest on one drill a day, and it is the shortest one in your plan.

mistake_one.title: You trust the first version
mistake_one.body: Whatever you took in first stays first, and a correction has to work twice as hard to replace it. That is a real strength on three of the four rounds, and it is the one the plan aims at the fourth.
mistake_one.fix: Say the new version out loud once. It files it as first.

styles.name: The Navigator
styles.blurb: You keep the map. Where a thing was gets filed with what it was, so you walk back to things other people have to go looking for, and you rarely notice you are doing it. The Navigator sharpens on its feet — three of your seven days are about moving.

mistake_one.title: You navigate instead of reading
mistake_one.body: Given a list and a layout you take the layout every time, which is fast — and faster still once you start drawing the layout yourself instead of waiting for one.
mistake_one.fix: Sketch it before you start. Two minutes buys the whole task.

styles.name: The Detector
styles.blurb: You notice the edit. Something moved and you knew before you could say what — the version in your head and the one in front of you refuse to agree quietly, and you are the one who says so. The Detector sharpens by looking a second longer, and that one habit lowers the number on its own.

mistake_one.title: You raise it before you have named it
mistake_one.body: You know something moved a beat before you know what, which is the earliest anybody catches it. The second beat, the one where you name it, is what the plan adds.
mistake_one.fix: Wait until you can point at it. The beat costs nothing.

styles.name: The Laser
styles.blurb: You go straight at it. Where other people scan the whole board, you land on the one thing that does not belong, and everything else stays out of focus until you are finished with it. The Laser sharpens by widening, which is the easiest gain in your plan and the one that lowers the number most.
